description: This Java class 'ExceptionHandling' provides utility methods for handling, logging, and inspecting exceptions within the MockServer project, including methods for handling throwables, closing channels, and detecting specific exception types.

classes.name: ExceptionHandling
classes.description: Utility class for exception handling, logging, and connection management in MockServer.

methods.name: handleThrowable
methods.description: Handles a CompletableFuture with timeout, logs exceptions, and rethrows as RuntimeException.

methods.name: handleThrowable
methods.description: Handles a Callable, logs exceptions, and rethrows as RuntimeException.

methods.name: swallowThrowable
methods.description: Executes a runnable and logs any thrown exceptions without rethrowing.

methods.name: closeOnFlush
methods.description: Closes a Netty Channel after flushing queued write requests.

methods.name: connectionClosedException
methods.description: Determines if a Throwable was caused by a closed connection, inspecting message and stack trace.

methods.name: sslHandshakeException
methods.description: Checks if a Throwable is related to SSL handshake failures.

methods.name: connectionException
methods.description: Checks if a Throwable is related to connection exceptions.

methods.name: getCauses
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the list of cause classes for a Throwable.
